description: The plot illustrates the performance of two models, 'SMoE Validating' and 'SimSMoE Validating,' in terms of Bits Per Character (BPC) across varying training steps. The x-axis represents 'Training Steps' on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick labels at intervals of 10 steps, expressed as (x10³) increments. The y-axis represents 'BPC,' also on a linear scale, with a range from 1.2 to 2.2, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The black line, representing 'SMoE Validating,' features a cross marker and a solid line style. It starts at a BPC value of approximately 1.7 at 0 training steps, showing a sharp declining trend till 1.25 at step 10 and leveling off at around 1.1 by 50,000 training steps. The magenta line represents 'SimSMoE Validating,' characterized by a circle marker and solid line style. This line starts at around 2.2 BPC at 0 training steps, showing a sharp declining trend till 1.25 at step 10, and stabilizing at approximately 1.15 BPC by 50,000 steps, slightly above the black line. Both lines exhibit a steep decline initially and become relatively stable as they progress along the x-axis. Notably, the SimSMoE model consistently outperforms the SMoE model across all training steps, as evidenced by its lower BPC values throughout the plot. A legend is provided in the top right corner.
